title: The diffraction-lensing interpretation of GW231123 with astrophysical priors
comment: 30 pages, 13 figures. Data and code available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21515053
summary: GW231123, if unlensed, is a rare binary black hole merger with high masses and high spins for both progenitors. We show that the signal is better fitted by a lower-mass, lower-spin merger that is diffraction-lensed by an isolated object of redshifted mass $\sim 1000\,\rm M_\odot$, modeled either as a point mass or as a spherically symmetric compact halo. Because diffraction-lensed events are also rare, hypothesis testing should quote the posterior odds ratio rather than the Bayes factor, which requires quantifying our prior belief in the two hypotheses. We adopt the GWTC-5 population distribution as our source parameter prior, and quantify the prior on the lens hypothesis through the lensing optical depth. For a point-mass lens, observational constraints on the abundance of black holes in the Universe yield an upper bound on the optical depth, and hence on the posterior odds, which do not rule out lensing. However, using a predicted mass function of intermediate-mass black holes formed in star clusters gives a low optical depth that strongly disfavors lensing. For a dark matter halo lens, standard collisionless cold dark matter does not form halos compact enough to give the required optical depth, but self-interacting dark matter with a large cross section at low velocities can trigger gravothermal collapse and form them, in which case the posterior odds are inconclusive. In either case, from a frequentist perspective, we show that detecting a lensed event with properties like GW231123 is unlikely. These conclusions apply to isolated lenses, while a lens embedded in an external gravitational potential could change the picture.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了GW231123引力波事件，发现它可能是由一颗约1000 M⊙的孤立天体（点质量或致密暗物质晕）衍射透镜效应产生的低质量、低自旋并合事件，而非原先认为的高质量、高自旋双黑洞并合。通过后验几率比（而非贝叶斯因子）进行假设检验，结果表明透镜假设的成立与否高度依赖于对透镜天体丰度的先验假设：基于观测约束的点质量透镜不排除透镜可能，但基于星团中中等质量黑洞预测质量函数的先验则强烈反对透镜；对于暗物质晕透镜，标准冷暗物质模型不支持，但自相互作用暗物质在特定条件下可能形成足够致密的晕，使得后验几率不具决定性。从频率主义角度看，检测到类似GW231123的透镜事件概率很低。
AI.motivation: 探究GW231123引力波信号是否可能由衍射透镜效应产生，而非最初认为的高质量、高自旋双黑洞并合，以更准确地理解该事件的物理起源。
AI.method: 采用后验几率比（posterior odds ratio）进行假设检验，以GWTC-5人口分布作为源参数先验，通过透镜光深度（lensing optical depth）量化透镜假设的先验；分别考虑点质量透镜和暗物质晕透镜两种模型，并结合观测约束与理论预测进行评估。
AI.result: 点质量透镜模型下，基于观测黑洞丰度的先验不排除透镜可能；但基于星团中IMBH预测质量函数则强烈反对透镜。自相互作用暗物质形成的致密晕可给出非决定性的后验几率，而标准冷暗物质无法形成足够致密的晕。频率主义分析表明检测到类似透镜事件的可能性很低。
AI.conclusion: GW231123是否由透镜效应产生高度依赖于对透镜天体丰度的先验假设，且孤立透镜模型下检测到此类事件的可能性较低；但若透镜嵌入外部引力势中，结论可能改变。

artifacts.abstract_zh: GW231123，如果未被透镜化，是一个罕见的双黑洞合并事件，其两个前身星都具有高质量和高自旋。我们表明，该信号更好地拟合为一个较低质量、较低自旋的合并事件，该事件被一个红移质量约为$\sim 1000\,\rm M_\odot$的孤立天体衍射透镜化，该天体可建模为点质量或球对称致密晕。由于衍射透镜事件也很罕见，假设检验应引用后验几率比而非贝叶斯因子，这需要量化我们对两种假设的先验信念。我们采用GWTC-5总体分布作为源参数先验，并通过透镜光学深度量化透镜假设的先验。对于点质量透镜，宇宙中黑洞丰度的观测约束给出了光学深度的上限，从而也给出了后验几率的上限，这并不排除透镜化。然而，使用在星团中形成的中间质量黑洞的预测质量函数，会得到较低的光学深度，从而强烈不利于透镜化。对于暗物质晕透镜，标准无碰撞冷暗物质无法形成足够致密的晕以提供所需的光学深度，但具有大截面（在低速下）的自相互作用暗物质可以触发引力热塌缩并形成它们，在这种情况下后验几率尚无定论。无论哪种情况，从频率论角度来看，我们表明探测到像GW231123这样具有特性的透镜事件的可能性很小。这些结论适用于孤立透镜，而嵌入外部引力势中的透镜可能会改变这一图景。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：GW231123是否由透镜效应产生高度依赖于对透镜天体丰度的先验假设，且孤立透镜模型下检测到此类事件的可能性较低；但若透镜嵌入外部引力势中，结论可能改变。

figures.caption_en: Table 1: Lensing posterior odds \(\mathcal{O}^{L}_{unL}\) for GW231123 using the NRSur7dq4 waveform model, and the frequentist probability \(p^{L}_{{obs}\geq 1}\) of detecting a GW231123-like lensed event from O1 to O4b. For the PM lens (Sec. IV.3.1 ), the \(f_{BH}\) and \(f_{PBH}\) rows are upper limits from observational constraints on the fraction of dark matter in general black holes (BHs) or primordial black holes (PBHs), assuming their mass is fine tuned to a constraint-satisfying optimal value \(M_{opt}\) . The last row assumes a mass function of intermediate-mass black hole (IMBH) lenses formed in star clusters. For the gSIS and CIS lenses (Sec. IV.3.4 ), the self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) rows assume a velocity dependent self-interacting cross section \(\sigma(v)\) that collapses a fraction \(f_{coll}\) of halos gravothermally, either taking \(f_{coll}=1\) or marginalizing over the \(\sigma(v)\) parameters for a Yukawa potential. Note that we assumed SIDM to be the correct DM model a priori for these rows. The NFW entry (Sec. IV.3.2 ), corresponding to a collisionless cold dark matter (CDM) halo whose abundance follows the halo mass function (HMF), is an order-of-magnitude estimate obtained by rescaling the gSIS result to the NFW optical depth. The last column \(p^{L}_{{obs}\geq 1}\) (Sec. V ) is the frequentist probability of detecting at least one lensed event with parameters as atypical as GW231123 over O1–O4b, where dashes mark the rows with an uninformative lens prior for which it is not defined. Error bars for \(\mathcal{O}^{L}_{unL}\) denote the \(90\%\) interval combining errors in the evidence integrals and the GWTC-5 hyperparameter uncertainties, while the uncertainties on \(p^{L}_{{obs}\geq 1}\) are obtained by sampling from the posterior of GW231123. The highlighted rows use the priors that most faithfully represent our prior belief.
figures.caption_zh: 表1：使用NRSur7dq4波形模型对GW231123的透镜后验几率\(\mathcal{O}^{L}_{unL}\)，以及从O1到O4b探测到类似GW231123的透镜事件的频率论概率\(p^{L}_{{obs}\geq 1}\)。对于PM透镜（第IV.3.1节），\(f_{BH}\)和\(f_{PBH}\)行是来自一般黑洞（BHs）或原初黑洞（PBHs）中暗物质占比的观测约束的上限，假设其质量微调至满足约束的最优值\(M_{opt}\)。最后一行假设了在星团中形成的中间质量黑洞（IMBH）透镜的质量函数。对于gSIS和CIS透镜（第IV.3.4节），自相互作用暗物质（SIDM）行假设了一个速度依赖的自相互作用截面\(\sigma(v)\)，该截面使一部分\(f_{coll}\)的晕发生引力热塌缩，要么取\(f_{coll}=1\)，要么对Yukawa势的\(\sigma(v)\)参数进行边缘化。注意，对于这些行，我们先验地假设SIDM是正确的暗物质模型。NFW条目（第IV.3.2节），对应于一个无碰撞冷暗物质（CDM）晕，其丰度遵循晕质量函数（HMF），是通过将gSIS结果按NFW光学深度重新缩放得到的数量级估计。最后一列\(p^{L}_{{obs}\geq 1}\)（第V节）是在O1–O4b期间至少探测到一个参数与GW231123一样非典型的透镜事件的频率论概率，其中破折号标记了那些具有无信息透镜先验的行，对于这些行该概率未定义。\(\mathcal{O}^{L}_{unL}\)的误差棒表示结合证据积分误差和GWTC-5超参数不确定性的\(90\%\)区间，而\(p^{L}_{{obs}\geq 1}\)的不确定性通过从GW231123的后验中采样获得。高亮显示的行使用了最能代表我们先验信念的先验。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: The posterior probability distribution of the lens parameters when the point mass (PM, blue), generalized singular isothermal sphere (gSIS, orange) and cored isothermal sphere (CIS, green) models are applied to GW231123, using the NRSur7dq4 (NRSur, solid contours) and IMRPhenomXPHM-SpinTaylor (XPHM, dashed contours) waveform models to model the source gravitational waveform. Top: the posterior in the redshifted lens mass ( \(M_{Lz}\) ) vs dimensionless impact parameter ( \(y\) ) plane. The shape of the posterior approximately follows lines of constant effective time delay between the two dominant images \(\Delta\tilde{T}=8M_{Lz}y\) (gray dotted lines). Bottom: The posterior distribution of the additional lens parameters: density profile power-law slope \(k\) (see Eq. ( 13 )) for the gSIS model (left), and the dimensionless core radius \(x_{c}\) (see Eq. ( 17 )) for the CIS model (right) vs \(y\) . We excise the region near the caustic curves (gray hatches) by setting the prior probability to zero because our lensing amplification factor computation is not accurate in those regimes.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：当点质量（PM，蓝色）、广义奇异等温球（gSIS，橙色）和带核等温球（CIS，绿色）模型应用于GW231123时，透镜参数的后验概率分布，使用NRSur7dq4（NRSur，实线轮廓）和IMRPhenomXPHM-SpinTaylor（XPHM，虚线轮廓）波形模型来模拟源引力波形。上：红移透镜质量（\(M_{Lz}\)）与无量纲碰撞参数（\(y\)）平面上的后验。后验的形状大致遵循两个主导像之间的有效时间延迟常数线\(\Delta\tilde{T}=8M_{Lz}y\)（灰色虚线）。下：额外透镜参数的后验分布：gSIS模型的密度轮廓幂律斜率\(k\)（见公式（13））（左），以及CIS模型的无量纲核半径\(x_{c}\)（见公式（17））（右）与\(y\)的关系。我们将靠近焦散曲线（灰色阴影）的区域排除，因为在这些区域我们的透镜放大因子计算不准确。

Left: the posterior distribution of the source-frame primary mass \(m_{1}\) and secondary mass \(m_{2}\) . The gray region ( \(m_{1} Right: the posterior distribution of the magnitude of the spin of the primary \(|\chi_{1}|\) and secondary \(|\chi_{2}|\) black hole. The posteriors shift to lower masses and lower spins and the two waveform models give compatible results when a lens model is applied.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：当未透镜化（unL，黑色）、PM（蓝色）、gSIS（橙色）和CIS（绿色）模型应用于GW231123时，源双黑洞参数的后验概率分布，使用NRSur7dq4（NRSur，实线轮廓）和IMRPhenomXPHM-SpinTaylor（XPHM，虚线轮廓）波形模型来模拟源引力波形。左：源帧主质量\(m_{1}\)和次质量\(m_{2}\)的后验分布。灰色区域（\(m_{1}右：主黑洞自旋大小\(|\chi_{1}|\)和次黑洞自旋大小\(|\chi_{2}|\)的后验分布。当应用透镜模型时，后验向较低质量和较低自旋移动，并且两个波形模型给出兼容的结果。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: The maximum likelihood whitened time-domain waveform of the unlensed (unL, black), PM (blue), gSIS (orange) and CIS (green) analyses using the NRSur7dq4 (NRSur) waveform model superimposed on the whitened detector data strain (gray) of the LIGO Hanford (top) and Livingston (bottom) detectors for GW231123. The lensed and unlensed waveforms deviate visually at around \(t-t_{event}\gtrsim 20\,ms\) , consistent with the rest of the literature studying this event. We do not show the IMRPhenomXPHM-SpinTaylor waveforms to avoid clutter.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：使用NRSur7dq4（NRSur）波形模型的未透镜化（unL，黑色）、PM（蓝色）、gSIS（橙色）和CIS（绿色）分析的最大似然白化时域波形，叠加在GW231123的LIGO Hanford（上）和Livingston（下）探测器的白化探测器数据应变（灰色）上。透镜化和未透镜化波形在\(t-t_{event}\gtrsim 20\,ms\)附近视觉上出现偏差，这与研究该事件的其他文献一致。为避免杂乱，我们不展示IMRPhenomXPHM-SpinTaylor波形。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: The distribution of likelihood for the posterior samples of each lens and waveform model. The bulk of the distribution for the lensed models agree with each other and are shifted higher compared to the unlensed ones.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：每个透镜和波形模型的后验样本的似然分布。透镜化模型分布的总体彼此一致，并且与未透镜化模型相比向更高值偏移。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Top panels: the prior reweighting factor \(\pi_{astro}/\pi_{PE}\) (red curve), which is the ratio between the astrophysical prior (inferred from population of events in GWTC-5) and the uninformative prior used in PE. Bottom panels: the posterior distribution for each lens and waveform model under the uninformative PE prior for the source-frame primary mass \(m_{1}\) , mass ratio \(q\) , luminosity distance \(d_{L}\) , spin magnitudes of the primary \(|\chi_{1}|\) and secondary \(|\chi_{2}|\) , and spin tilt angles of the primary \(\cos\theta_{1}\) and secondary \(\cos\theta_{2}\) . The reweighting factor favors the lensed hypothesis for \(m_{1}\) , \(d_{L}\) , \(|\chi_{1}|\) and \(|\chi_{2}|\) , and favors the unlensed hypothesis for \(q\) .
figures.caption_zh: 图5：上：先验重加权因子\(\pi_{astro}/\pi_{PE}\)（红色曲线），即天体物理先验（从GWTC-5中的事件总体推断）与参数估计中使用的无信息先验之比。下：在无信息参数估计先验下，每个透镜和波形模型关于源帧主质量\(m_{1}\)、质量比\(q\)、光度距离\(d_{L}\)、主自旋大小\(|\chi_{1}|\)和次自旋大小\(|\chi_{2}|\)、以及主自旋倾斜角\(\cos\theta_{1}\)和次自旋倾斜角\(\cos\theta_{2}\)的后验分布。重加权因子对于\(m_{1}\)、\(d_{L}\)、\(|\chi_{1}|\)和\(|\chi_{2}|\)有利于透镜化假设，而对于\(q\)有利于未透镜化假设。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Observational constraints on the fraction of dark matter attributable to general BHs or PBHs, \(f_{BH}(M)\) , as a function of the black hole mass \(M\) , assuming a monochromatic mass function. The thin curves show the upper limit from individual channels, with the region above each curve excluded. The PBH-only channels (CMB accretion and the GW merger rate) are drawn dashed, while the remaining channels apply to BHs of any origin. The two thick gray curves are the combined envelopes (the channel-wise minimum) that we feed into the optical depth calculation: the solid curve ( \(f_{BH}\) ) drops the PBH-only bounds and represents the full BH population, while the dashed curve ( \(f_{PBH}\) ) includes them and represents the PBH-only case. The vertical blue lines mark the optimal lens mass \(M_{opt}\) that maximizes the posterior odds under each envelope for the NRSur7dq4 posterior (see Sec. IV.3.1 ). The right axis shows the corresponding dark matter density fraction \(\Omega_{BH}=f_{BH}\,\Omega_{DM}\) . The constraint compilation is taken from Ref. Carr and Kuhnel ( 2022 ) and references therein.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：可归因于一般黑洞或原初黑洞的暗物质占比\(f_{BH}(M)\)作为黑洞质量\(M\)函数的观测约束，假设单色质量函数。细曲线显示来自各个通道的上限，每条曲线上方的区域被排除。仅原初黑洞的通道（CMB吸积和引力波合并率）用虚线绘制，而其余通道适用于任何起源的黑洞。两条粗灰色曲线是我们输入光学深度计算的组合包络（按通道取最小值）：实线曲线（\(f_{BH}\)）去掉了仅原初黑洞的界限，代表整个黑洞总体，而虚线曲线（\(f_{PBH}\)）包含它们，代表仅原初黑洞的情况。垂直蓝线标记了在NRSur7dq4后验下（见第IV.3.1节）每个包络下最大化后验几率的最优透镜质量\(M_{opt}\)。右轴显示相应的暗物质密度占比\(\Omega_{BH}=f_{BH}\,\Omega_{DM}\)。约束汇编取自参考文献Carr and Kuhnel (2022)及其中的引用。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: Relationship between the virial mass \(M^{NFW}_{vir}\) , redshifted lens mass \(M_{Lz}\) , and the differential optical depth \(d\tau_{y Left: \((1+z_{L})M^{NFW}_{vir}\) as a function of \(M_{Lz}\) , fixing \(z_{L}=0.4\) and \(z_{S}=0.8\) . For a regular NFW halo in collisionless CDM, \(M_{Lz}\) is orders of magnitude smaller than \(M^{NFW}_{vir}\) because the inner profile \(\rho(r)\sim r^{-1}\) is gentle. For a halo in SIDM that started as an NFW halo with \(M^{NFW}_{vir}\) and later forms a collapsed core, \(M_{Lz}\) is much closer to \(M^{NFW}_{vir}\) because the inner profile \(\rho(r)\sim r^{-2.19}\) is steep, allowing more effective mass to contribute to the lensing effects. These collapsed halos can be modeled by the gSIS profile with \(k=1.19\) for lensing purposes. Right: The differential optical depth \(d\tau_{y<2}/d\log_{10}M_{Lz}\) as a function of \(M_{Lz}\) for a source at redshift \(z_{S}=0.8\) , with the lens redshift integrated over \(0<z_{L}<z_{S}\) . For IMBH lenses formed in star clusters, the differential optical depth is low, \(\lesssim 10^{-9}\) . For the collisionless CDM case, as \(M^{NFW}_{vir}\) is higher, the abundance of these halos is lower according to the halo mass function, which along with the small Jacobian \(dM^{NFW}_{vir}/dM_{Lz}\) gives rise to an even lower optical depth. For the SIDM case, we show the differential optical depth if we assume that all halos would collapse ( \(f_{coll}=1\) , solid orange line) and if we compute \(f_{coll}\) by marginalizing over the parameters governing the functional form of \(\sigma(v)\) (dashed orange line), both orders of magnitude higher than the IMBH and NFW cases.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：维里质量\(M^{NFW}_{vir}\)、红移透镜质量\(M_{Lz}\)和微分光学深度\(d\tau_{y左：\((1+z_{L})M^{NFW}_{vir}\)作为\(M_{Lz}\)的函数，固定\(z_{L}=0.4\)和\(z_{S}=0.8\)。对于无碰撞CDM中的常规NFW晕，\(M_{Lz}\)比\(M^{NFW}_{vir}\)小几个数量级，因为内部轮廓\(\rho(r)\sim r^{-1}\)是平缓的。对于SIDM中起始为具有\(M^{NFW}_{vir}\)的NFW晕并随后形成塌缩核的晕，\(M_{Lz}\)更接近\(M^{NFW}_{vir}\)，因为内部轮廓\(\rho(r)\sim r^{-2.19}\)是陡峭的，允许更多有效质量对透镜效应做出贡献。这些塌缩晕可以用透镜目的下的gSIS轮廓（\(k=1.19\)）来建模。右：对于红移\(z_{S}=0.8\)的源，微分光学深度\(d\tau_{y<2}/d\log_{10}M_{Lz}\)作为\(M_{Lz}\)的函数，透镜红移在\(0<z_{L}<z_{S}\)上积分。对于在星团中形成的IMBH透镜，微分光学深度较低，\(\lesssim 10^{-9}\)。对于无碰撞CDM情况，由于\(M^{NFW}_{vir}\)更高，根据晕质量函数这些晕的丰度更低，再加上小的雅可比行列式\(dM^{NFW}_{vir}/dM_{Lz}\)，导致光学深度甚至更低。对于SIDM情况，我们展示了假设所有晕都会塌缩（\(f_{coll}=1\)，实橙色线）以及通过边缘化控制\(\sigma(v)\)函数形式的参数来计算\(f_{coll}\)（虚线橙色线）时的微分光学深度，两者都比IMBH和NFW情况高几个数量级。
